categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Feinan Resources Recycling Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the disposal of hazardous waste containing non-ferrous metals and the recycling of renewable resources. The company operates a comprehensive business model covering hazardous waste collection, harmless disposal, and resource recovery, focusing on industrial hazardous waste with metal content. It produces and sells resource products such as electrolytic copper, nickel powder, zinc ingots, tin solder ingots, gold, silver, and palladium powder.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced metallurgical processes including oxygen-enriched side-blowing smelting, copper balance hazardous solid waste batching, oxygen-enriched reduction smelting, rare oxygen combustion refining, low-grade black copper electrolysis, and multi-metal recovery technologies. These technologies enable efficient and deep resource recovery from complex hazardous waste materials, achieving high metal recovery rates and producing high-purity recycled metals.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are industrial enterprises generating hazardous waste, primarily from chemical, metal processing, electronics, and mining sectors. The company serves customers mainly in Guangdong, Jiangxi, Guangxi, and other Chinese provinces, focusing on supplying high-purity recycled metals to downstream industries such as copper processing and metal manufacturing. The top five customers accounted for over 62% of sales revenue in 2024.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with production bases in Guangdong (Zhaoqing and Foshan), Jiangxi, Guangxi, and other provinces. It holds hazardous waste operation licenses covering multiple provinces, with significant capacity in Guangdong and Guangxi. The company’s sales and operations are concentrated domestically, with no significant overseas operations reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangdong Feinan operates primarily in the midstream segment of the hazardous waste and metal recycling supply chain. It collects hazardous waste from upstream industrial producers, processes and recycles metals, and supplies refined metal products downstream to manufacturing and processing industries. The company also engages in resource recovery and deep processing, closing the loop in the circular economy.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation in hazardous waste treatment and metal recovery, focusing on green and efficient processing technologies such as oxygen-enriched smelting and advanced refining. R&D projects target reducing emissions, improving metal recovery rates, and developing new products like electrolytic nickel and high-purity metal powders. The company aims to enhance its multi-metal deep resource recovery capabilities and promote sustainable, zero-waste industrial practices.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of recycled metal products derived from hazardous waste processing. The company also earns fees for hazardous waste disposal services. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales contracts, with pricing linked to metal content and market metal prices. The company uses spot and contract sales, with payment typically on a cash-on-delivery basis.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The hazardous waste disposal and resource recycling industry in China is fragmented with many small players. Guangdong Feinan positions itself as a leading large-scale enterprise with advanced technology and comprehensive hazardous waste treatment licenses. It holds a competitive advantage through its multi-metal deep resource recovery capabilities and scale, ranking among the top in Guangdong province for hazardous waste processing capacity.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 12.57 billion, a 45% increase from 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 128 million. Total assets reached RMB 12.58 billion, growing 18.6% year-over-year. The company has shown strong revenue growth driven by capacity expansion and new projects, although net profit declined due to increased costs and market fluctuations. Cash flow from operations improved significantly compared to the prior year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Guangdong Feinan offers integrated hazardous waste disposal combined with high-efficiency, deep multi-metal resource recovery, producing high-purity recycled metals. Its proprietary metallurgical technologies enable processing of complex hazardous waste with high metal recovery rates and low environmental impact. The company’s scale, technical expertise, and stable supply chain relationships provide customers with reliable, environmentally compliant, and cost-effective recycling solutions.
